comment: Production dependencies with known advisories that this server does not execute. Anything NOT listed here fails the Security workflow, and so does a NEW advisory id against a listed package -- the `advisories` array is what somebody actually reviewed, so a fresh one has to be looked at rather than inheriting the exemption. Review the reasons whenever the SDK is upgraded: an entry stops being true the moment src/ imports an HTTP transport.

hono.reason: Reached only through @modelcontextprotocol/sdk's HTTP transport. src/index.js imports server/stdio.js and never server/streamableHttp.js, so this code is installed but never loaded.

@hono/node-server.reason: Same path as hono: the SDK's HTTP transport, which this server does not use.

express-rate-limit.reason: SDK HTTP transport dependency. No HTTP listener runs in a stdio server.

ip-address.reason: Reached through express-rate-limit, itself part of the SDK's unused HTTP transport.

path-to-regexp.reason: Reached through express, part of the SDK's unused HTTP transport.

body-parser.reason: Reached through express, part of the SDK's unused HTTP transport.

qs.reason: Reached through express, part of the SDK's unused HTTP transport.
